summary:
• Kimi K3.1 Pro — Kimi's open‑weight multimodal model with 3 trillion parameters, image, code, and text support, and a million‑token context for long‑form tasks.
• Ripple‑65B Preview — Ripple's 65 billion‑parameter open‑weight LLM runs on‑prem or cloud with a million‑token window, delivering strong coding performance at low cost.
• Claude Code — Anthropic's coding assistant update adds session recording, AWS assume_role support, and an effort flag for token‑budget transparency.
• cvENGINE — Open‑source self‑hosted scanner correlates live assets with active CVE exploits, delivering a single prioritized verdict to reduce triage noise.
• Phonon — A tiny on‑device 31 million‑parameter text‑to‑speech model using flow‑matching, providing high‑quality multilingual speech without cloud dependence.
• Daybreak Red — OpenAI's GPT‑5.6 Cyber model available in AWS GovCloud, enabling compliant, state‑of‑the‑art LLM use for regulated cybersecurity workloads.
